# A local module is a provider: each instance binds its params, expands
# to its own targets, and forwards its outputs.
bit
stdout 'alice\.message ✔'
stdout 'bob\.message ✔'
stdout 'carol\.shout ✔'
grep '\Ahello alice!hello bob\?CAROL\z' combined.txt

bit
stdout 'combined · no changes'

# The command line can name an inner target, and -ll shows the nesting.
bit -ll
stdout '^  alice \(module\.module\)'
stdout '^    alice\.message \(exec\.exec\)'
bit alice.message
stdout 'alice\.message · no changes'

# Expressions can't reach an inner target.
cp BUILD.bit.inner BUILD.bit
! bit
stderr 'undefined field: alice\.message\.path'

# A required module param must be set.
cp BUILD.bit.missing BUILD.bit
! bit
stderr 'greeter\.bit:1:1: missing required param: name'

# Renamed with `as`, the alias calls the default resource bare.
cp BUILD.bit.alias BUILD.bit
bit
stdout 'dave\.message ✔'
stdout 'erin\.shout ✔'
grep '\Ahello dave!\z' greet-dave.txt

# --schema lists the default resource by the alias it's called by.
bit --schema --json
cp stdout schema.json
exec jq -e '.g.resources | map(.name) | sort == ["g", "g.loud"]' schema.json

-- mods/greeter/greeter.bit --
param name : string
param punct = "!"

message = exec {
  command = "printf 'hello %s%s' #{name} '#{punct}' > greet-#{name}.txt"
  outputs = "greet-#{name}.txt"
}

output file = message.path
-- mods/greeter/loud.bit --
param name : string

shout = exec {
  command = "printf '%s' #{name} | tr a-z A-Z > loud-#{name}.txt"
  outputs = "loud-#{name}.txt"
}

output file = shout.path
-- BUILD.bit --
import "./mods/greeter"

alice = greeter { name = "alice" }

bob = greeter {
  name = "bob"
  punct = "?"
}

carol = greeter.loud { name = "carol" }

combined = exec {
  command = "cat #{alice.file} #{bob.file} #{carol.file} > combined.txt"
  outputs = "combined.txt"
}
-- BUILD.bit.inner --
import "./mods/greeter"

alice = greeter { name = "alice" }

leak = exec {
  command = "cat #{alice.message.path}"
}
-- BUILD.bit.alias --
import "./mods/greeter" as g

dave = g { name = "dave" }
erin = g.loud { name = "erin" }
-- BUILD.bit.missing --
import "./mods/greeter"

nobody = greeter { punct = "." }
